name: mil188qammod
expr: y16 = mil188qammod(x16, 16); rt16 = isequal(x16, mil188qamdemod(y16, 16)); y32 = mil188qammod(x32, 32); rt32 = isequal(x32, mil188qamdemod(y32, 32)); y64 = mil188qammod(x64, 64); rt64 = isequal(x64, mil188qamdemod(y64, 64)); rtN64 = isequal(x64, mil188qamdemod(y64 + 0.01*(1+1i), 64));
comment: MATLAB mil188qammod / mil188qamdemod (MIL-STD-188-110 QAM). Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on M=16, M=32, AND M=64 constellations. All tables hard-coded per MATLAB's spec-rounded values (probed at %.17g). KNOWN GAP narrowed: only M=256 still deferred. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship mil188qam in core; reports N/A.
